addTo.label: Add keel plate to
addTo.tooltip: Add a keel plate to supported, or all, trinkets.

enabled.label: Keel plate
enabled.tooltip: Let th' keel plate be conjured up

engraved.label: Add haul name to keel plate
engraved.tooltip: Carve th' haul name and XYZ resolution in µm onto th' keel plate.

meshShape.label: Net shape
meshShape.tooltip: Choosin' a shape other than None will punch a pattern o' holes in th' keel plate o' the chosen shape.

meshSize.label: Net size
meshSize.tooltip: Th' diameter o' holes in th' keel plate.

meshWidth.label: Net width
meshWidth.tooltip: Thickness o' th' walls between th' holes.

placement.label: Stowage
placement.tooltip:
Where th' keel plate sits relative to each trinket and its supports.
  • Underneath - shift trinkets and supports up, and place th' haul plate underneath.
  • Intersecting - intersect th' haul plate with th' bottom o' the trinket or its support.

thickness.label: Stoutness
thickness.tooltip: How thick th' keel plate be, in millimetres.

type.label: Kind
type.tooltip:
Keel plate kind:
  • Full - cover th' whole platform with a keel plate
  • Shadow - cover regions directly below th' trinkets.
  • Bounding Box - cover th' bounding o' each trinket.

label.overrideMaterialSettings: Enterin' values in these fields will override th' defaults set by th' grog.

message.changesApplyToNewParts: Existin' trinkets will be updated with th' new chart riggin' and sent back to th' line o' waitin' for forgin'.
message.deleteTemplateWarning: Any trinkets usin' this chart will be sent back to th' Crow's Nest for review. Assign a new chart to forge 'em, or reject 'em to scuttle 'em from th' Funnel.
message.modifyWillAffectParts: Associated trinket types usin' this chart will rejoin th' line o' waitin' for forgin', and any scuttled trinket types will be sent back to th' Crow's Nest for review.
message.modifyWillRequeueParts: Existin' trinkets will be updated with th' new chart riggin' and sent back to th' line o' waitin' for forgin'.
message.noTemplatesInfo: Charts will be listed here. Use th' 'Create' button to draw yer first chart.

accuracyZ.label: Accuracy Z
accuracyZ.tooltip: Th' slice thickness used to autogenerate structures and avoid intersectin' with th' trinket.

aspectRatio.label: Aspect ratio
aspectRatio.tooltip: Controls how quick support structures widen out.

connectGap.label: Connect gap
connectGap.tooltip: Number o' lattice levels to suppress connection after a vertical connection was found (available).

connection.label: Connection
connection.tooltip: Number o' nodes to connect on th' lattice level below. Settin' this value to 0 will make flexible supports.

contactWidth.label: Contact width
contactWidth.tooltip:
For default supports: Width o' th' support structure where it touches th' trinket.

For lattice supports: Width o' th' contact ball where it touches th' trinket.

halfContactWidth.label: Half contact width
halfContactWidth.tooltip: Have another go at addin' contact points with half th' width.

heightLevel.label: Height level
heightLevel.tooltip: Apply a Z-margin between th' trinkets and th' platform.

islandWidth.label: Island width
islandWidth.tooltip:
For default supports: Width o' th' support structure upon first contact with th' trinket.

For lattice supports: Width o' th' contact ball upon first contact for each trinket body.

lattice.label: Lattice
lattice.tooltip: Enable lattice supports. Lattice supports weave a riggin' o' interconnected beams around th' model.

layout.label: Spread
layout.tooltip: How nodes be spread over XY positions.

margin.label: Margin
margin.tooltip: Extra distance from th' trinket to steer clear o' collisions.

maximumWidth.label: Maximum width
maximumWidth.tooltip: Limits th' width o' support structures at th' base.

minimumHeight.label: Minimum height
minimumHeight.tooltip: Avoid addin' re-intersectin' supports if their height be less than th' specified height.

modelInterSupport.label: Model intersupport
modelInterSupport.tooltip: Allow support columns that reintersect and stand on th' trinket.

selfSupportAngle.label: Self-support angle
selfSupportAngle.tooltip: Th' angle in degrees from horizontal that needs no supports.

sideFaces.label: Side faces
sideFaces.tooltip: Sets th' number o' side faces for new support structures.

sideFeaturesSize.label: Side-feature size
sideFeaturesSize.tooltip: How far a detail can jut out from a surface without bein' supported.

spacingXY.label: Spacing XY
spacingXY.tooltip: Distance between nodes over th' XY plane

spacingZ.label: Spacing Z
spacingZ.tooltip: Distance between lattice levels over th' Z axis.

supportSpacing.label: Support spacing
supportSpacing.tooltip: Distance between support points on a trinket.

tallestSupport.label: Tallest support
tallestSupport.tooltip: Ignore any supportable feature above th' specified height.

undershoot.label: Under/Over-shoot
undershoot.tooltip:
For default supports: Th' maximum injected distance where th' support point enters th' trinket.

For lattice supports: Distance from th' contact point where th' structure starts to taper to a point.

tooltip.fastPrintMode:
<bold>Fast forgin' mode</bold>
Speeds up all non-essential haul platform movements, smartly repositionin' between layers to cut idle time and shorten th' total forgin' duration.
tooltip.separationDetect:
<bold>Separation detect</bold>
Spies th' film releasin', reducin' lift distance between layers.

May risk forgin' defects if separation isn't properly sensed.
